content: The corpora we use for training the model are OpenSubtitles2018 BIBREF15 , Europarl BIBREF16 , JRC-Acquis and EMEA BIBREF17 . We assume that there should be sufficient stylistic difference between these corpora, especially between the more informal OpenSubtitles2018 (comprised of movie and TV subtitles) on one hand and Europarl and JRC-Acquis (proceedings and documents of the European Parliament) on the other.
